data.title: 猫猫 · 海滨药草茶的苦味研究
data.description: 猫猫穿着深绿色泳装外搭短披肩，坐在海边摊位前研究一杯冷泡药草茶；她尝过后皱眉，又加了一片柑橘，把调好的杯子推向镜头，蓝瞳里全是“这次可以了”的认真。
data.location: harbor herb market by the sea
data.action: 海港摊位试喝冷泡药草茶，调好苦味后把成品推向镜头
data.lighting: clear afternoon light on glass and green leaves
data.mood: 把假日也做成一场药理研究
data.promptProse: She slides the herbal tea toward the viewer across the harbor stall, a citrus slice on the rim and satisfaction in her gaze. Clear afternoon light catches the glass and green herb leaves.
data.animaCaption: She slides the tea toward the viewer across the harbor stall.
